title: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker and former knight of Bant who commands the tower's mechanical garrison and defends it with Jodah against a Phyrexian attack.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A four-thousand-year-old archmage who rides with Elspeth and uses Jaya's pouch spell with her to destroy a Phyrexian behemoth; he is stabbed by Rona.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker who senses two melodies in Elspeth.

entities.name: Seven
entities.description: Wrenn's partner tree.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrives at the tower and guards Teferi during the attack.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A fire planeswalker who arrives at the tower, shares wine with Jodah in mourning for Jaya, and vows to save Ajani.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artificer who built the mechanical soldiers, watchtower upgrades and powerstone lances, and keeps the Temporal Anchor running.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who maintains her ghostform around Teferi during the Anchor's operation.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker preparing to travel in time inside the Temporal Anchor.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: A Phyrexian in Jodah-like robes with a glaive and azure lightning who wounds Jodah and Elspeth, bearing a grudge from Yavimaya.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker serving the Phyrexians who spares Elspeth and carries off the wounded Rona.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker, compleated by the Phyrexians; Elspeth's friend whom she resolves to save.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Jodah's and Chandra's dead friend, who left behind a spell in a pouch.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: An artificer from Urborg who fought beside Elspeth and whom Jodah once punched.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A fallen friend toasted by the group.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: A figure Elspeth speaks to and hopes can hear her.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: An ally of Elspeth who is alive.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who has proven a true friend to Elspeth.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A Theros god, chained in the Underworld, whom Elspeth despises.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: Bant's guardian angel to whom Elspeth once prayed.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A god on Dominaria.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: A god who set Calix on his quarry.

entities.name: Calix
entities.description: A construct of fate who pursues Elspeth from plane to plane.

entities.name: Daxos of Meletis
entities.description: A servant of Heliod, subject of a dream in which Elspeth kills him.

entities.name: Aran
entities.description: A squire Elspeth once mentored on Bant.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: The author of the letters, a nightmare-weaver who calls themselves Elspeth's most dedicated admirer.

entities.name: Boy
entities.description: A prisoner who escaped with Elspeth's plan on New Capenna but was captured and Phyrexianized.

entities.name: Urza's tower
entities.description: The open tower on Dominaria that the Coalition holds.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: The time machine being run in Saheeli's workshop.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: Elspeth's white healing light.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who attack the tower with infantry, mounted units, winged knights and a giant skyship.

entities.name: Mechanical soldiers
entities.description: Saheeli's automaton garrison that Elspeth commands.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The plane where Elspeth suffered, with a Phyrexian asylum.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the tower stands.

events.summary: Elspeth, unable to sleep, drills in the tower's grand hall and admits her skills feel sluggish after New Capenna.
events.quote: But after all her experiences on New Capenna, her movements had felt sluggish, her sword arm shaky.

events.summary: Wrenn tells Elspeth she lives two melodies, one in light and one in shadow, and Elspeth angrily denies it.
events.quote: It is as if you live two separate lives. One in light, one in shadow.

events.summary: Wrenn senses visitors, and Elspeth confronts two figures glowing green in the rain.
Nissa and Chandra arrive at the tower and Elspeth hands them to Kaya for debriefing.
events.quote: Nissa Revane and Chandra Nalaar walked into the light.

events.summary: At a watchtower, Elspeth sets up one of Saheeli's cylinder turrets and tries to pray, remembering that Ajani is compleated.
events.quote: Elspeth pulled a steel-clad cylinder from her sack

events.summary: Elspeth speaks quietly to Giada about her hatred for the Phyrexians and her failures.
events.quote: And I hate them so much for what they did to Ajani.

events.summary: Chandra and Jodah, drinking in the hall, toast and reminisce about the dead Jaya.
events.quote: Let me have one turn on Saheeli's time machine, and I'd go back

events.summary: Elspeth joins them and speaks of Venser; Jodah reveals he is four thousand years old, and Chandra vows to save Ajani and burn the Phyrexians.
A Phyrexian attack begins at night; Elspeth finds Saheeli and Kaya straining to keep the Anchor running for Teferi.
events.quote: The Phyrexian attack came in the dead of night.

events.summary: A Phyrexian skyship overpowers the watchtowers, and Elspeth orders Wrenn and Nissa to protect Teferi.
events.quote: Wrenn and Nissa, protect Teferi at all costs.

events.summary: Elspeth wakes the mechanical garrison and clay brutes and sets them in defense arcs.
events.quote: All at once, the hundred or so mechanical soldiers stomped to life

events.summary: Jodah unveils a staked trench and fire to impale the Phyrexian vanguard, and Elspeth and Jodah charge with powerstone lances that unleash scything bands of energy.
events.quote: Jodah unwove the phantasmal terrain spell he'd cast the previous day

events.summary: Elspeth fights through the horde with her sword and Halo, then orders the mechanical legion to charge.
events.quote: Upon hearing the command word, the metal legion defending the keep turned into aggressors

events.summary: The skyship unfolds into a giant legged behemoth heading for the tower.
events.quote: Several more gargantuan legs sprouted from the bottom of the skyship's hull

events.summary: Jodah leads Elspeth in casting Jaya's spell, and she channels her hope of saving Ajani, producing a blaze that destroys the behemoth.
events.quote: A column of radiance poured out of her

events.summary: Ashiok's letter recounts how Elspeth and a prisoner called Boy tried to hide among corpses in a Phyrexian asylum on New Capenna; Boy was caught and Phyrexianized.
events.quote: Thanks to your Planeswalker spark, you escaped, but Boy wasn't as fortunate.

events.summary: Rona appears, blasts Elspeth and Jodah with lightning, and stabs Jodah in the gut as revenge for Yavimaya.
events.quote: This is for the trouble you caused me in Yavimaya,

events.summary: Elspeth wounds Rona with her sword, though her arm is run through by the glaive.
events.quote: burying her sword deep into Rona's shoulder.

events.summary: Tezzeret arrives, spares Elspeth, tells her to disappear before the tower falls, and carries off Rona.
events.quote: I suggest you take this opportunity to find somewhere remote and disappear.

relations.note: They fight together and Jodah comforts her.
Elspeth hopes to save the compleated Ajani.
relations.quote: But another part of her needed him here, needed there to be a chance of saving him like Chandra insisted.

relations.note: Rona stabs Jodah for the trouble he caused in Yavimaya.
relations.quote: This is for the trouble you caused me in Yavimaya,

relations.note: Tezzeret carries Rona off and reproves her.
relations.quote: Next time, aim for the neck.

relations.note: Calix pursues Elspeth by Klothys's order.
relations.quote: He dreams about his quarry dictated by Klothys

relations.note: Calix chases Elspeth from plane to plane.
relations.quote: his life consumed with the pursuit of Elspeth Tirel

relations.note: Daxos is forced to carry out Heliod's will.
relations.quote: he is forced to carry out the sun's will

relations.note: Aran was Elspeth's squire whom she mentored.
relations.quote: More than once, you chided Aran on his handling of a blade.

relations.note: Saheeli built the garrison Elspeth commands.
relations.quote: In a matter of days, the hall had become increasingly crowded with Saheeli's metal soldiers.
